Vandal Day One Access List

Click the link below to view a full list of courses that are using Vandal Day One Access (Inclusive Access). You'll be able to see which courses have associated Day One fees for digital materials in the current term.

Vandal Day One Access gives students automatic access to required digital course materials through Canvas on the first day of class. Enrollment is automatic for students registered in participating courses, but you may choose to opt out during the first 10 days of class if you prefer to provide or obtain materials independently.
